nodes.name: Generation composition
nodes.responsibility: Starts the private child, then builds each generation's object graph over a transport and identity ledger that outlive it

nodes.name: Codex transport
nodes.responsibility: One newline-framed JSON object at a time each way, correlated to its request, and each tool call routed to the owner registered for its namespace

nodes.name: Codex session
nodes.responsibility: One initialized session and the reviewed methods it will send

nodes.name: Thread link
nodes.responsibility: Which workhorse each tab session and checkout is bound to, under its link key, made by the first message or Talk in that checkout: the binding, and the refusal when two disagree

nodes.name: Voice coordinator
nodes.responsibility: The separate fast thread each tab session's voice attaches to, started with the tab's first message or Talk: the voice model's subconscious, which routes sustained work to a named checkout's workhorse

nodes.name: Epoch ledger
nodes.responsibility: Which child generation owns which thread, on disk, with staged operations that commit or roll back

nodes.name: Workhorse operations
nodes.responsibility: The four things the coordinator may ask of the workhorse of a checkout it names, one at a time: delegate, steer, inspect, manage its queue; each workhorse has its own

nodes.name: Approvals
nodes.responsibility: Every approval the child raises: staged, published to the tab session whose thread asked, answered exactly once, settled

nodes.name: Thread tool calls
nodes.responsibility: The archboard_app tools a thread calls on the server's other threads: list, read, create, fork, message, wait

nodes.name: Context delivery
nodes.responsibility: Tells one workhorse each context change a host announces for its checkout: one quiet developer message, settled once

nodes.name: Conversation start
nodes.responsibility: Starts a conversation on a chat's first message or Talk: the tab's coordinator ready first, then the workhorse of the shown checkout, then its context delivery bound to it

nodes.name: Workhorse start
nodes.responsibility: Opens the thread one workhorse's link will name, with its instructions and both tool manifests, under a staged epoch operation

nodes.name: Session workhorses
nodes.responsibility: One workhorse for each checkout of a tab session: its starter, context delivery, queue, operations and link actions, built on first use

nodes.name: Child ownership
nodes.responsibility: Owns the private Codex child and what outlives each generation of it: the process, the transport, the protocol session, the ledger of which generation owns a thread, and unloading idle threads

nodes.name: Chat conversations
nodes.responsibility: What a chat sees and says: the gateway with its lease, snapshots and commands, the start of a conversation, the list of the tab's workhorses, and the approvals raised to the person

nodes.name: Workhorses
nodes.responsibility: The sustained work of each checkout: a workhorse's thread link, queue, operations, start and context delivery, built per tab session on first use, with its tool calls

nodes.name: Voice
nodes.responsibility: The separate fast coordinator thread of a tab session, its realtime voice leg, and the callbacks that tell it and the voice model workhorse news and context changes while voice is live

nodes.name: Turn execution
nodes.responsibility: Implements delegation, steering, inspection and queue changes through the shared operation runtime

nodes.name: Operation validation
nodes.responsibility: Captures the current binding and classifies both linked threads around each coordinator effect

nodes.name: Start contract
nodes.responsibility: Defines the starter port that exposes thread creation and its current snapshot

edges.label: the transport a restarted child rejoins
thread/start, fork and turn/start for a tool call
thread/read and thread/list to classify a link
turn/interrupt the turn each stopped workhorse runs
stop_workhorses: stop every running workhorse of the tab
read the link the chat named before starting anything
stage, commit or roll back the start
classify and recheck the captured links
